items.title: Solving the Knapsack Problem with Evolutionary Algorithms
items.summary: The Knapsack problem is a famous optimization problem in computer science that deals with filling up a knapsack with items to maximize value. The problem has been studied since 1897 and involves finding the optimal combination of items to maximize value while not exceeding the knapsack's maximum weight.
